svg.text: Cover silhouettes at true pixel size, clean and charred

1 unit = 1.147 px: a fighter is 75 units, 86 px (the grey figure at each row's left). Each shape at the middle of its height range; the left is clean, the right charred (burned: a black trunk and branches, or stubs and ash). Flat faces, a keyline stroke (not geometry).
Triangles are of the flat mesh: every polygon fanned, every thin line a quad. The tools that draw this: art/concepts/biomes/covers.mjs. Concept art for Rendering; no character art.
beach, plains, savanna, forest, jungle, desert, mountains, volcanic, tundra
